universe: U2; stocks need prior-day median SIP spread <= 3 bp; the 15 ETFs always
bars: 1m IEX RTH, forward-filled closes; 5m and 10m bars built from 1m aligned to 09:30; prior session prepended for EMA warm-up; a higher-TF bar is used only once complete
trend_a: close > EMA20 (of that TF's closes) AND EMA20[now] - EMA20[3 bars ago] > 0
trend_b: last 3 bars: highs strictly rising AND lows strictly rising
down (short mirror): close < EMA20 and slope < 0 / lower highs + lower lows
S1: first minute all three TFs (1/5/10) are up
S2: 5m and 10m up; 1m close crosses from <= its EMA20 to > its EMA20 (the pull-back-then-turn; with an EMA cross the pull-back is implied)
S3: control: first minute the 10m trend turns up (at a 10m bar close), lower TFs ignored
window: decision 09:45-15:30 ET; one signal per name per signal type per 15 min
entry: open of the next 1m bar (close of the signal bar if that minute has no IEX bar)
exits: hold 15/30/60/120 min, or when the 5m trend is no longer up (checked at each 5m close), all capped at 15:50
cost: full SIP spread at entry (round-1 model fitted on U2 samples)
baselines: random: every-5-min entries in the same name, same day, same clock hour, same exit rule; S3 for S1/S2
promote_to_holdout: net > 0 on tune AND validate, pooled tune+validate day-clustered t >= 2.0, AND beats random on both; max 3 cells by t; holdout run once
